name: dual-panel-comparator
title: Dual Panel Comparator
description: Side-by-side comparison layout for diffs, AB variants, or before-and-after evaluations.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Side By Side Comparison: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
